title: Hand-harvested Lemon-glazed German Sausage Braise
description: A hearty, citrusy braise featuring hand-harvested German sausage, with a tangy lemon glaze and a rich, unctuous sauce. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Heavy Cream
ingredients.notes: Optional, can be substituted with half-and-half or milk

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a donabe over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce until smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the freshly squeezed lemon juice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sausages and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
